description: EXPERIMENTAL: hotels on Booking.com for a location and stay window, scraped from the search-results page: name, nightly price, review score + count, star class, image and a direct booking link per property. Booking sits behind AWS WAF, so the call may return a blocked error — google_hotels_search is the reliable alternative (and covers Booking's prices among OTAs). Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, experimental, query, search_url, location, checkin, checkout, currency, count, hotels: [...] } — the list key is `hotels`. Each hotel: { name, price_per_night, currency, rating, reviews, hotel_class, booking_url, thumbnail } (fields are null when Booking omits them).

currency.description: ISO currency for prices (e.g. 'PLN', 'EUR'). Omit for Booking's default for the region.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh Booking.com fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

name: booking_search_hotels
title: Search Booking.com hotels (experimental)
